style: A calm, assured principal product engineer presenting to hackathon judges. Crisp international English, warm but restrained, medium pace, short deliberate pauses around numbers and proof claims. Never sound like an advertisement.

segments.text: Prediction apps ask whether Ether goes up or down. OutcomeGuard starts with exposure you already own, and turns a downside concern into bounded, verifiable protection.

Here, I define a one-thousand-dollar Ether exposure, a one-hour horizon, a two-percent downside scenario, a fifteen test-USDC premium cap, two-percent slippage, and seventy-five-percent target protection. Structured controls remain authoritative; AI never controls arithmetic or permissions.

OutcomeGuard scopes the DreamDEX venue on Shannon chain fifty-thousand three-hundred twelve, discovers an eligible Event Contract, and verifies Trading status on-chain. It reads the real book, spread, visible depth, expiry, settlement reference, tick, lot, minimum quantity, block, and freshness.

The deterministic engine begins with portfolio loss, derives DOWN shares, then caps and quantizes them by premium, executable depth, price impact, spread, lot size, and portfolio limits. The same calculation object drives this chart and the receipt. This is conditional protection, not a price forecast or a perfect hedge.

Every control is visible. Required unknowns fail closed, and the identical policy engine runs at preview and immediately before signing. If the book moves beyond tolerance, the market approaches expiry, or any mandate input changes, authorization is invalidated.

This linked evidence is from OutcomeGuard's dedicated Shannon test agent. The bounded I-O-C bought four-point-one-seven-one NO shares and spent one-point-nine-one-four-four-eight-nine test-USDC. A hash alone is never confirmation: OutcomeGuard requires a successful mined receipt, decoded fill, and a reconciled on-chain position.

Intent, market snapshot, hedge math, policy results, authorization, and chain evidence are canonicalized and sealed with SHA two-fifty-six. Change any sealed field and verification fails. Each later lifecycle record links the previous digest, so history cannot be silently rewritten.

The market then resolved DOWN. Four-point-one-seven-one test-USDC became claimable, redemption succeeded on Shannon, and the winning-token balance reconciled to zero. The trade, settlement, and redemption are independently inspectable from this final receipt.
OutcomeGuard turns Event Contracts from a prediction interface into a policy-bound protection layer for wallets and treasuries.
